notes.title: Localization & Release Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Launch Update[/b][/p][p]We’ve made the tough decision to delay the release of [i]Boomerang Jack[/i], now coming [b]a few months later than planned[/b]. Our goal has always been to deliver a polished, exciting adventure from day one, and we need a bit more time to make sure it’s the best it can be.
[/p][p]We’re also excited to confirm that [i]Boomerang Jack[/i] will launch with [b]full localization[/b] -- English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Turkish and more! [/p][p]In the meantime, we’ll keep sharing progress updates and behind-the-scenes looks as we wrap up development. Thank you so much for your patience, your wishlists, and your support, it means the world to us and helps us bring [i]Boomerang Jack[/i] to life the right way.[/p][p]— The Recall Interactive Team[/p]

notes.title: Coming 2025! New trailer & demo...
notes.content:
After years of development, we finally have a release window -- [b]Early 2025[/b]! Check out the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010010/Boomerang_Jack/]extended trailer[/url] to see our work.

2024 has been a crazy year for the team, and we've made significant progress towards fleshing out locations you'll cross on your globe-trotting adventure. Travel through [b]deserts, caves, swamps, volcanoes, ships, ruins[/b] and more!

In order to stop the Pirate King, you'll also need to upgrade Jack's abilities - boomerang, kick, dash, shockwave to turn into lethal weapons that [b]fit YOUR playstyle[/b]. Obsessed with kicking bottles? Kick a bottle at the last second to split into 3 and hit 3 foes. Dash through enemies to spawn mini-AOEs. Do damage with your shockwave, and hit multiple enemies to multiply the effects! Perhaps my favorite is the ability to do one dash without any recovery period or roll. This comes in handy in the [b]7 multi-phase boss fights[/b] you'll encounter along your way. 

Boomerang combos are a huge area to experiment with, and though its perfectly fine to stick with the basics, mastering new pause combos or hold combos can give you a leg up on late-game foes. Alternatively, contextual moves like the [b]dash combos[/b] are more intuitive and great for keeping enemies at bay and doing damage over time. Upgrading Jack to fit your playstyle is essential to defeating the Pirate King, but [b]mastery[/b] of the mechanics, movement, and enemy designs is equally important!

Lastly, as we wrap up development for release in just a few months, we ask for your feedback in our discord. You may get a glimpse into unreleased content!
